Surface 2: "Name the individual who headed the establishment of the Syrian transitional government as its President." Surface 3: "The Syrian transitional government was set up under the presidency of which key figure?" I checked the answer against each and they all give "Ahmed al-Sharaa."

After drafting these, I double-checked that all questions are clear and answerable. I'm focusing on ensuring that the question style varied sufficiently while keeping it focused on the core facts. I'm satisfied that none of the questions contain any hint that would give away the answer.
